[LGRA.5.7a.2] A schema-typed slot is written once, by the kwarg of the `emit`
that asserts its fact or of the `publish` that sends it. Reading the
nested fact's slots via chained dotted access (`b.pan.capacity_l`) is
not supported in v1 — the slot value is a fact pointer, not an inlined
struct. Denormalize: copy needed slots onto the parent schema directly.
